title: Maneno ya Heshima na Adabu (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the relative on a family tree, then uses the kinship word of respect for that place (shangazi, mjomba, binamu, babu, mkwe).
representations: a role play of a family visit
steps: Find the person on the tree.
contexts: time and seasons: a family gathering

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "shangazi" and labels three more places on the tree.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Dada ya baba yako anaitwaje?" Kwa nini "mjomba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Dada ya baba ni shangazi. Kaka wa mama ni mjomba.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto humsalimia babu kwa kusema ___." Kwa nini "marahaba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mdogo humsalimia mkubwa kwa "shikamoo", na mkubwa hujibu "marahaba".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto wa shangazi yako anaitwaje?" Kwa nini "kaka" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mtoto wa shangazi au mjomba ni binamu, si kaka wala dada.

misconceptions.ask: Mtu huyu ni nani kwako katika familia?
misconceptions.repair: Mama wa mke huitwa mama mkwe.

checks.question: Kaka wa mama ni nani kwako?
Mtoto wa shangazi ni nani kwako?
